title: Root CLAUDE.md must never be tracked in this PUBLIC repo (GOV-F01) — it was tracked once (01648d102 / PR #4551) and disclosed prod Neon project/branch/operating_company_id identifiers; untracked again in f5cdf067a (PR #5528). Shrink-only ratchet against re-tracking; does NOT remove the old disclosure from public git history — that needs an owner-approved history rewrite, out of autonomous scope.

LAW = ENFORCED GUARD, OR IT IS NOT LAW — every NEW rule ships a guard registered in docs/law/LAW.json; verify-law-registry.mjs is a required check that reddens when a registered law's guard file is missing
RLS is NOT a backstop for Owner sessions — org.user_accessible_company_ids() returns every active company, so every read carries its own entity predicate (CLS-JOIN-ENTITY-UNSCOPED)
WORM / void-not-delete — financial rows are voided or soft-deleted, never physically DELETEd
TRK is the sole asset holder — depreciation and Accumulated Depreciation book on the owner entity, never on the lessee (TRANSP/USMCA own no assets today)
ALL TMS-native data is TEST; only the TRANSP QBO mirror is real — QBO-origin documents are correctly unposted and must never be backfilled into the TMS GL
Findings flow AGENT → BOARD → AGENT, never through the owner — a defect in another lane is written as an OPEN row in docs/audit/GUARD-WORKORDERS.md
Lane roles — CC-1 money/GL/WORM, CC-3 mechanical/entity-scope/FE/CI-guards, CC-2 GUARD verify-live-never-build, CASCADE merger
ANSWERED = CLOSED — an owner decision written in a locked file is closed; re-asking it is a process defect and a question never stops the loop
CONTINUOUS MODE — pull the top OPEN board item in your lane, build to standard, arm merge, emit one line, start the next; never idle, never pause to summarize
§1 Sidebar is additive-only; the count source of truth is SIDEBAR_ITEM_IDS in sidebar-config.ts, never a number written in prose
§2 Cash Flow is a top-level MODULE at /cash-flow between eld and accounting — not a report, and it must not import /reports/cash-flow-*
§3 Insurance delegates all financial math to computeInsuranceDispersal — no new ledger math; bill writes carry an idempotency key
§8.3 Parallel double-books — TMS never writes back to QBO; the JE push path is gated by QBO_JE_PUSH_ENABLED plus a structural refusal of any source_system != 'tms'
§10 The Accounting sub-nav is the approved grouped CLICK-open dropdown row; the flat clean-tabs render cannot silently return
§10 Accounting navigation is TOP-BAR ONLY — never a left rail (QboAccountingSubNav.tsx must stay absent)
Rule 16 — every shipped-code commit carries the Definition-of-Done evidence block (FINDING/LANE/DOD-A..E/VERIFY-1..8/ROOT CAUSE/FIX/GUARD/LIVE PROOF/REMAINING)
Rule 23 — money-path PRs may not ship theater; MODULE_PROGRESS + VERIFY-1..8 + live proof are mandatory on money and migration commits
Rule 24 — a module is DONE only as an explicit N of M in docs/module-completion/, never as a prose claim
Rule 25 — money-pr-local-gate runs first on pre-push; one push after local PASS, never rebase while build-typecheck runs
Rule 25 bands — verify-step numbers are claimed from disjoint mod-4 bands (Cursor EVEN · CC-1 ≡1 · CC-2 ≡3) so parallel lanes cannot collide
Rule 29 — every lane runs the same expanded local gate before every push; never --no-verify
Rule 30 — the tip commit's LIVE PROOF must be Claude-green (a real exit code / sha / row), never 'UNVERIFIED browser' theater
Rule 37 — a verify-step number must already be on origin/main's CLAIMED-NUMBERS.json before the step file is authored
Rule 07 — archive, never delete; a branch may not delete a scripts/verify-*.mjs or verify-step that exists on origin/main
Rule 06 — never take the short way, never defer a root cause, never fake-green; build to surpass QBO/NetSuite/McLeod/Alvys
Rule 15 — ground every recommendation in verified live state plus fresh research of how the reference systems actually do it
Schema canonicals — accounting.* (never finance.*), audit.row_changes, driver_finance.*, mdata.qbo_*, banking.*, maintenance.*; there is NO ih35_app data schema
Every new schema adds USAGE + table GRANTs for ih35_app (migration 0065 pattern) or it 500s at runtime
An applied migration is checksum-frozen — never edit a migration that has already run
§7 Palette is LOCKED — navy/slate/bg tokens only; --green-pill is the Class pill, --red is delete/Accident; off-palette status colour is a ratchet that may only shrink
§7 Work-order display ID is WO-{UNIT}-{TYPE}-{MM-DD-YYYY}-{NNNN}-{V5} over the 7 immutable source types
§7 Every reference dropdown carries an inline '+ Add new ___' that writes the CANONICAL table, never a mdata.qbo_* mirror
CLS-UUID-LABEL — a human-facing link or picker option is never labelled with a raw or truncated uuid
No silent list caps — a screen that fetches a hard cap must surface the truncation; the ratchet may only shrink
A display ID is unique PER ENTITY, not globally — every display-id lookup carries its entity predicate
Safety is 28 tabs / 9 groups sourced from SAFETY_TABS_CONFIG.ts — never a count written in prose
Test units (unit_number LIKE 'TEST-%') are forbidden in prod
Block-20.3 — closed-period cash-basis output is snapshotted at period close and read-only thereafter; closed-period reads return the snapshot, never a recompute
Block-20.2 — the basis selector renders only on Balance Sheet, Trial Balance, P&L and Reports Home; Cash Flow, AR/AP Aging and IFTA stay accrual-only

A workflow may not key its concurrency group on a bare ref — a queued run that never executed can otherwise be cancelled into a permanently dead required check, leaving the PR unmergeable with no code failure

Every path stamping mdata.load_stops.actual_departure_at must write a real clock value (now() or COALESCE onto now()), never a bare client parameter — that stamp is the delivery evidence revenue recognition and invoice gating hang off

display_id is unique only per (operating_company_id, display_id) — it may never be an equality lookup key without an entity predicate; resolve money documents by UUID (PERMANENT LAW B: void by UUID, never display_id)

A component that owns a polling query is a page-level singleton — mounting it inside a .map()ed child multiplies both the render and the prod read rate by the collection length, silently and with no visual error

A route may not SET app.operating_company_id to a company the caller named without first asserting the caller belongs to it — RLS then enforces whatever the attacker asked for, and an accessible-companies predicate is not a membership check because user_accessible_company_ids() returns every active company for an Owner

A route that writes an invite must prove the caller belongs to the invited driver's company BEFORE the write — a membership guard scoped by helper-import is vacuous, because a route with zero asserts is exactly the vulnerable state and is invisible to it

setScopedCompanyContext must assert company membership before setting app.operating_company_id — it concentrates the cross-entity authorization of every handler that delegates to it, and a call-site guard cannot see it break
A nav/leaf that drills through to detail (bill row, Chart-of-Accounts reachability, cash-flow 7-day strip) may not silently lose its drill-through wiring

Every dispatch Kanban lane dropStatus must be a status loadStatusSchema accepts AND must reach the money-aware /dispatch transition (or be an explicitly listed pre-dispatch exception) — a lane whose drop the API rejects is a silent dead end, and after #4769 a lane the mapper does not handle silently falls back to the non-money mdata path, stamping no departure and opening no settlement; all three ends live in separate files owned by separate lanes so they drift independently

A business date (YYYY-MM-DD) must never be pinned to UTC for display — it has no timezone, and new Date(iso+"T00:00:00Z") renders one day early for every viewer west of UTC, which silently showed the wrong day cash position in Central Time

NEVER GUESS · NEVER DEFER · ALWAYS VERIFY · ALWAYS FIX, NEVER PATCH — every change fixes the root cause at its source, ships a guard that fails on the bug and passes on the fix, and is proven live on prod; CI-green is the floor, not the verdict; when a fact cannot be verified the required output is UNVERIFIED, never a guess

The Programs by-class scoreboard is GENERATED from docs/audit/wave-queue.json and must match it — a board that renders stale class status is trusted precisely because it looks authoritative, so drift must fail the build rather than mislead

EVERY by-id load read the detail drawer can land on must RESOLVE the primary driver name and unit number, not only carry their ids — a drawer that renders a covered load as "Unassigned" invites double-assignment; the entity predicates on those joins must scope units by the owner/leased pair; and the assertion is per-route, because a LIST query resolving the names does not make the by-id payload carry them
Work is drained VERTICALLY by CLASS, globally and universally — never module-by-module, never the old block way

The load assignment-history trail must name the drivers it records and must assert company membership before setting the RLS scope — a uuid prefix is not an identification of a person, and a caller-supplied company is not an authorization

Every CC-3 finding is written to the board AND listed in docs/audit/CC-3-FINDINGS-CHECKLIST.md; the coder who fixes it ticks its own row with coder+PR+date+live-proof+guard, never CC-3; a tick without that evidence is a false completion claim; CC-3 re-verifies live and stamps VERIFIED or reopens

Every finding is filed in four locks same turn (board OPEN + register ☐ + Desktop routing + OUTBOX); FIXED requires five proofs same turn as merge (main grep + guard + register ☑ + board/routing FIXED); anti-resurrection before OPEN; cross-lane skip without filing is forbidden

A driver's A/P vendor must be RESOLVED through the shared entity-scoped resolver and a miss must THROW — never a fallback to the driver's own id, which put driver pay into A/P against a vendor that does not exist and made the DRIVER_VENDOR_MISSING check dead code (0 of 181 prod drivers carry qbo_vendor_id, so the fallback was the only reachable branch)

A bill's vendor must resolve inside the bill's OWN entity — an unresolvable vendor is an error, never a NULL FK (which escapes the ACCT-F142 duplicate index, partial on mdata_vendor_id IS NOT NULL) and never a pass-through uuid (which the single-column bills_mdata_vendor_id_fkey accepts from another entity)

A board panel must not depend on an unauthenticated runtime GitHub call — a visibility change empties it silently, and an empty array is indistinguishable from 'nothing happened'; derive it from the ledger at generation time

A status board must be served from the source of truth at REQUEST time, not rendered from a committed build artifact — a generated module can only change on a redeploy, so the Programs by-class grid silently drifted to 26 classes while the wave queue held 31; and where a fallback is shown, the board must say so

set_config('app.operating_company_id', …, true) is TRANSACTION-LOCAL — setting it on a raw pool.connect() client with no BEGIN sets nothing, it is discarded before the next statement (proven on PostgreSQL 16.14), so every FORCED-RLS policy sees an empty scope; use withCurrentUser, which opens the transaction and issues SET LOCAL ROLE ih35_app fail-closed

A query must not filter a status column on a literal the column's CHECK constraint forbids — A/R aging excluded accounting.invoices.status 'voided', a value invoices_status_check makes impossible (the real spelling is 'void'), so the exclusion could never fire and rested on voided_at alone; one invoice with status='void' and voided_at NULL was counted, and USMCA reported $4,325.50 of receivables where $1,875.50 was real

A phantom column in the SELECT LIST is as fatal as one in WHERE — both throw 42703 and 500 the endpoint — so verify-sql-column-existence must check PROJECTED columns, not only WHERE/SET/ORDER-BY ones; a select-list-only phantom passed the guard with exit 0 while the route it lived in failed on every call

Voiding a bill payment must reverse its GL, and no caller may opt out by hardcoding the flag — voidBillPayment passed reversePostedGl:false, so every void through the UI reversed nothing while the panel promised an equal-and-opposite entry and the GL kept $33.40 of cash that had already left the bank; the decision is a property of the payment (a non-cash settlement deduction has no GL of its own), never of the caller
Lanes do not edit each other's domain territory; shared append-only registries are union-merged, never owned

A POD/BOL captured at a stop must be linked to its PARENT LOAD (docs.file_links has no load_stop entity type, so dropping the link orphans the evidence), and the hop.pod_bol scenario probe must COUNT the canonical stores the office reads back — dispatch.pod_documents + dispatch.bol_documents — not only the document library

A GL poster that opens its OWN connection must never be awaited from inside an open transaction — under READ COMMITTED that second connection cannot see the caller's uncommitted writes, so the poster's evidence gate re-read a delivery departure the caller had just stamped, found NULL, returned missing_delivery_evidence and posted nothing while every static guard stayed green; defer it with enqueueAfterCommit(client, …) so it runs after COMMIT, and drop the queue on ROLLBACK and on ROLLBACK TO SAVEPOINT so a side effect never outlives the write that justified it

A guard that scopes delivery paths by a STRING-LITERAL status match is green-while-broken — the bulk route writes the status from a variable and its one literal sits inside a Set, so the file was never considered and verify-delivery-evidence-latch-wired printed OK exit 0 while bulk 'Mark delivered' stamped delivery evidence and never latched revenue; scope on stampFinalActiveDeliveryDeparture(), a shared call name that cannot be written as a variable

driver_finance.driver_settlements is the ONE money create type with no writable free-text column, so is_sample_data is the ONLY Gate-B tag path — and NAMING the column is not enough: the load-bookended writer (the one dispatch calls on in_transit) named it and then supplied the LITERAL false, so every settlement a sample load auto-opened was hardcoded "not sample data" while the guard sat green; every production INSERT must both name the column AND derive its value from the parent row (load for the dispatch/bookended writer, driver for the weekly close), never a literal, because the writers that strand untagged money are precisely the ones no human calls by hand

The app-layer vendor_type allow-list must equal the mdata.vendors CHECK constraint, case-normalised — a bare z.string() over a case-sensitive closed CHECK turns the most likely input ('other') into an opaque HTTP 500/23514 instead of a 400 naming the legal values; every DB CHECK/enum needs an app-layer counterpart that fails FIRST

A success toast must report the status the SERVER returned, never the one the click intended — save_mode 'book_dispatch' does not force 'dispatched', so asserting dispatch from the local save mode told a dispatcher a truck was rolling under an audited DOT override while the load sat at assigned_not_dispatched

The book-load submit handler must not silently discard operator input — every stop field the form registers AND the backend can persist must appear in the stops payload; postal_code was omitted from the explicit allow-list, so 0 of 20 prod load_stops ever carried the PC*MILER routing key that driver pay-per-mile and IFTA jurisdiction miles depend on

A to_regclass table-presence probe must declare what its FALSE branch means — throw, fail closed, or degrade WITH a signal; a bare permissive return silently disables the control (notifications.suppression_rules FAILED OPEN and mailed every suppressed recipient). Ratcheted per file against a frozen baseline so the class cannot grow while individual sites are dispositioned

A banner that tells the operator what a feature flag is doing must READ that flag — two Banking banners asserted 'stays OFF by default' from literals while BANK_FEED_GL_POSTING_ENABLED and TRANSFER_GL_POSTING_ENABLED were overridden ON for all three entities, so categorizing a row posted a real balanced journal entry the operator had just been told would not exist

A customer-payment (A/R receipt) GL post must run on the CALLER'S transaction — postSourceTransactionInClientTx. The pool-connection poster opens a second connection where the caller's uncommitted payment and applications are invisible, so it silently posts nothing: the subledger moves, the GL stays dark, and the subledger-to-GL tie-out fails (USMCA: 3 payments, $1,287.25, zero postings; an invoice reading 'paid' against GL A/R still carrying $1,200.00)

A delivery has TWO money halves and a guard that checks only one is green while the other is dark: latchOnDeliveryEvidence recognises the revenue, while pingSettlementOnLoadEvent on delivered_pending_docs calls closeSettlementForFinalLoad and closes the driver trip settlement — four of the five production latch paths (office fallback, driver route, bulk mark-delivered, driver-PWA departure) fired the latch and never pinged, leaving revenue on the books and the settlement that pays the driver OPEN FOREVER while verify-delivery-evidence-latch-wired stayed correctly green because it only ever asked about one half; every production route firing the latch must also ping settlement, non-fatally, and the guard must assert the PAIR rather than the call

A GenericCatalogConfig may not assume a physical `deactivated_at` column exists on its table — Postgres resolves column references at PLAN time, so an unconditional reference 500s on EVERY request for any table lacking it, independent of data. 30 of 30 generic catalog configs lack an explicit hasDeactivatedAt declaration and 6 factory SQL sites reference deactivated_at unconditionally (LV-CAT-500, live-confirmed 2026-08-06). Every config must declare hasDeactivatedAt explicitly and every deactivated_at SQL reference in the factory must be gated on it. Guard is mutation-proven (--selftest PASS) but currently RED against the live tree (36 offenders) and NOT YET CI-wired — Cascade holds no verify-step band (same gap as CC-3; see scripts/.guard-exempt.json), so wiring is deferred to whichever banded lane (CC-2/Cursor) authors the fix under CLS-SCHEMA-DRIFT. This is the audit red-inventory baseline, not a fixed/enforced state. Fix authorship belongs to the mechanical lane, not Cascade.

CLS-CALENDAR — invoice send/post SQL that binds a calendar date must use a Postgres-safe date string (toISOString().slice(0,10) or equivalent), never String(Date) which is not castable to ::date and blocks the money send path
Matrix vertical wiring — one column id or one codebase class swept across every module that owes it (priority 10 gate; extend to 28); module-deep slices and seat module subsets forbidden

HONEST BUILT + LAUNCH LAW — launch-ready without Live Chrome = Fully-Wired 1–11 with leaf-specific Built only; ban leafRe:.* / |.* / word-blanket Built; seat lanes Cursor/CC-1/Codex permanent; no new scoreboard columns; soft Done while theater remains is a defect
picker_law @matrix-built / wire-sprint Built claims must not match more than 40 Required leaves in one shot — prefix-family theater ban (HONEST-BUILT companion)

Fully-Wired item 7 surface-bar create-drawer inventory — every Modal/ParityDrawer create shell in FE must have required.json leaf.surface_path or explicit FILE_OWNED_BY_LEAF/ALLOWED_NESTED map (no fuzzy theater)

Fully-Wired item 7 surface-bar toolbar inventory — every chrome.toolbar_* matrix leaf must carry an allowlisted surface_path to UniversalListToolbar / ParityTable / DataTable / ListView / TableControls / TableSearch (no null-path theater)
Fully-Wired item 7 surface-bar wizard inventory — every FE *Wizard*.tsx must have required.json leaf.surface_path or explicit FILE_OWNED_BY_LEAF (steps / shared StepWizard shells)
Fully-Wired item 7 surface-bar Modal inventory — every FE <Modal open=> host must have required.json leaf.surface_path or explicit FILE_OWNED_BY_LEAF/ALLOWED_NESTED map (no fuzzy theater)

Fully-Wired item 7 surface-bar ParityDrawer inventory — every FE <ParityDrawer open=> host must have required.json leaf.surface_path or explicit FILE_OWNED_BY_LEAF/ALLOWED_NESTED map (no fuzzy theater)
Fully-Wired item 7 surface-bar Combobox inventory — every FE <Combobox> host must have required.json leaf.surface_path or explicit FILE_OWNED_BY_LEAF/ALLOWED_NESTED map (no fuzzy theater)

FULLY WIRED = complete 12-item bar (create→canonical · money · F+R · matrix · surface bar every control→matrix · chrome · pickers · RLS · guard · Live Chrome LAST) plus item 13 GL delta (C25–C31) — soft yes to owner without this list is a defect
C25-C31 must exist in columns.shared.json AND every URGENT_16 module required.json (seven ids + economics.invariants leaf). Chrome walks cannot satisfy them.
Seat loop incomplete without ledger query-back of created rows; lead re-reads healthz every turn; no false complete; TRANSP WF 6103 is operating_bank; C25-C31 on URGENT_16 required.json
G1 is is_sample_data labeling not test-in-prod; opening $0 OB and negative TEST bank are cutover design; 9000 detector not fail-closed; keep TEST on books; void only to test void or true need; no CPA
MODULE_PROGRESS N of N is illegal while REMAINING is non-empty; MODULE_PROGRESS requires Live=
No bulk void/delete of TEST rows keyed on is_sample_data or TEST/SAMPLE memo; keep on books

geofences gain a real EntityLink kind — EntityLink.tsx kind=geofence resolves to /dispatch/geofencing?geofence_id=, GeofencesPage.tsx reads that param and highlights the row (was previously write-only, no consumer), GeofenceBreachesTab.tsx's geofence label drills through instead of rendering dead text

Box 3 Built claims (@matrix-built tags + wire-sprint-built.json) must be leaf-specific — a match-all leafRe (".*", "^.*$", ".+", "^.+$", or empty) can never credit a column as Built for every leaf in every listed module; violates FULLY-WIRED item 6. New/changed claims hard-fail; the 63-entry legacy corpus is tracked backlog for the vertical-column sweep, not silently-green Built

factors gain a real EntityLink kind — EntityLink.tsx kind=factor resolves to /factoring/factors?factor_id=, FactorAdmin.tsx reads that param and resolves the full Factor object from factorsQuery to highlight the row, ReserveDashboard.tsx + ReserveTracker.tsx's per-balance factor labels drill through instead of rendering dead text

LoadCreateModal's repair-block banner renders the blocking asset as a real EntityLink kind=unit instead of dead text — confirmed against the backend's own dispatcher-facing label (load-assign.routes.ts) that asset_id is always a unit here, not a guess

accounting ap_bill money-cell gap closed to 0 — PayBillModal, CCPaymentModal, BillDetailPanel, VendorBillForm (VendorBillCreatePage), and BillPaymentModal each carry a verified vendor + CoA/bank-account + bill-reference contract, proven (not assumed) via the real submit payloads and EntityLinks in each file

banking money-cell gap closed to 0 — matched_bill_id (already selected by /api/v1/banking/plaid/company-transactions) is now joined to accounting.bills for a human label and rendered as a real EntityLink on the transactions surface, matching the load/settlement/journal_entry pattern already present

reports money-cell gap closed to 0 — 11 leaves' false ap_bill Required marking removed (GL-rollup reports own no bill-level data: trial_balance/profit_loss/balance_sheet/cash_flow*/settlement_summary/customer_profitability/maintenance_cost_per_unit/runner.cash_position/report.ar_aging; documented in reports.required.json honesty_audit), and report.ap_aging + report.management's genuine vendor-level ap_bill wiring given real leaf-specific proof instead of the removed broad claim

compliance + fleet money-cell gaps closed to 0/1->0-remaining — compliance's 3 false ap_bill Requireds removed (property_tax.list/detail post a direct GL JE with zero accounting.bills row; form2290 is a pure filing tracker with zero bill_id anywhere); fleet's 3 false ap_bill Requireds removed (roster.row.edit_unit/unit.profile.maintenance/trailer.profile.maintenance surface no accounting.bills data — WO/parts widgets show vendor_invoice_number as a plain string, never a real bill FK) while fleet's genuinely-wired unit.detail.finance_linkage (real Unit->Bill reverse drill, tenant+unit-scoped) gets a real leaf-specific Built guard instead of riding the removed broad claim

home + insurance + inventory + legal money-cell gaps closed to 0 — 9 leaves' false ap_bill Required markings removed with live per-leaf evidence: home's role.accountant (aggregate KPI/aging-bucket totals only, zero bill_id across 4 sub-widgets) and jump.accounting (a static nav card, no bill data rendered); insurance's policies.create/detail/claims.create/lawsuits.create (insurer vendor_id is real, but premiums route through the standalone insurance.payment_schedules mark-paid tracker with no bill FK, same direct-posting pattern as property tax); inventory's assignments.vendor_link (real vendor EntityLink, but vendor_invoice_number/amount are plain captured fields, not a bill FK); legal's matters.create (create-only form, zero bill/vendor fields — the real linked-costs bills array lives on the separate matters.detail leaf, not flagged as gapped)

maintenance money-cell gap closed — 13 of 15 flagged leaves' false ap_bill Required markings removed (wo.create/wo.source.is|es|ac|et|rt|it|rs are WO-list/create surfaces with zero bill_id anywhere; road_service.active, parts_inventory.record_purchase (real vendor_id, but last_purchase_invoice_number is a plain string not a bill FK), warranty.create_claim, maintenance.modal.fault_rule, and maintenance.modal.create_expense all own zero bill data), while the 2 genuinely-wired leaves (wo.create_bill + maintenance.modal.create_bill — the SAME CreateBillModal.tsx, a real createVendorBill call persisting a hard accounting.bills.work_order_id FK, reusing the canonical VendorBillForm) get a real leaf-specific Built guard instead of riding the removed broad claim — closes the OWNER-EXECUTION-PLAN §2 all-8-module ap_bill money-cell sweep (compliance/fleet/home/insurance/inventory/legal/maintenance/reports)

verify-wave-c-ap-bill-fe-all-modules.mjs's own fixed floors (p10<27, leaves<67, module-Set<12) were the count-floor-not-proof pattern LINK-F5156 named this guard as evidence of — they broke on the very next run after ACCT-F5158..F5161 honestly dropped the ap_bill count from 67+ to 39 (5 of 12 modules now correctly own zero ap_bill leaves), because a floor cannot distinguish real wiring loss from an honest false-claim correction; floors removed, replaced with per-leaf auditConnectivity + the unchanged file-pattern/composed-guard checks, module list corrected to the honest 7 (accounting/banking/fleet/maintenance/reports/settlements/vendors) in both the guard's own @matrix-built tag and wire-sprint-built.json

verify-matrix-built-leaf-specific.mjs's new-vs-legacy ratchet gated "new" purely by FILE path (branchTouchedFiles) — docs/specs/scoreboard/wire-sprint-built.json is a single shared feed holding 8+ independent broad-claim entries (ap_bill/load/trailer/unit/vendor/customer/driver/connectivity), so editing ONE entry's modules list (an honest correction, same pattern as ACCT-F5162) flagged ALL 8 as new/changed and would have hard-blocked the exact legitimate metadata fix this guard is supposed to allow for already-legacy entries; same problem for any scripts/verify-*.mjs file whose @matrix-built tag's modules list is corrected without narrowing leafRe. Fixed with identity-based diffing (new exported splitNewVsLegacy()): an entry is only "new" if no broad-claim entry with the same (file, task) identity existed in origin/main's committed state, fetched via git show/git ls-tree, fail-open to "everything new" if origin/main is unreachable. Verified to still catch a genuinely new broad-claim task and a leaf-specific-to-broad regression on an existing task, both via real selftest cases (not just manual spot-checks).

trailer-column vertical sweep across all 6 modules that ever claimed it (dispatch/fleet/lists/insurance/maintenance/safety) — live per-leaf verification of all 115 flagged leaves via 4 parallel read-only investigations found 64 false blanket Required markings (removed, honesty_audit-documented; the entire `lists` module's 20 fleet-catalog pages own zero trailer leaves — pure catalog-VALUE CRUD, no trailer record reference) and 2 real product bugs masquerading as wiring gaps (FleetTable.tsx's roster row Edit button always opened the unit-only EditVehicleModal regardless of row.kind, never branching to EditTrailerModal for trailer rows; TransfersInProgressPage.tsx labeled every row "Unit:" with EntityLink kind="unit" even though row.equipment_id is always sourced from mdata.equipment/trailers, never mdata.units) — both fixed in code, not just metadata, and their Required marking corrected from the wrong 'unit' to the now-genuinely-true 'trailer'. The 53 genuinely-wired leaves (TrailerProfilePage.tsx's 13 self-referential sections + status/edit modals, fleet roster kind-branching, dispatch board/Book-Load/load-drawer/quick-assign/equipment-transfer, and real trailer pickers in fuel/insurance/maintenance/safety create flows) get 8 new leaf-specific Built guards instead of riding the removed WAVE-A-trailer-all-modules broad claim, whose own count floors (p10<49, leaves<93, module-Set<6) were proactively fixed in the SAME PR this time (see LINK-F5163's sibling ACCT-F5162 pattern) rather than shipped as a second self-caused regression.
